title: provenance_block
description: Spec IV shared building block. The spec writes site, corridor and row_flags as bare objects, so those three stay open and their contents are filled by ENGINE and WEATHER.

site.description: Site object as read from the site configuration. Open by specification.

corridor.description: Corridor object as read from the site configuration. Open by specification.

row_flags.description: Per-row VERIFIED or ASSUMPTION flags as read from the data files. Open by specification.
